client.reasoning: The tracker shows stages, Home and policy pages show renewal state, and Activity shows payment status; the tracker's progress ticks and its "declined" headline sit awkwardly together.
client.fix: Add a one-line "where this is now and who holds it" status banner at the top of every claim and renewal page.

broker.reasoning: Overdue, Answered and stage chips are clear and Release Check shows pass or fail, but the push test result is hard to read on the long page.
broker.fix: Add a persistent summary strip (counts overdue, awaiting approval) on every staff page.

client.reasoning: Plain-language actions and "?" explainers help, but some wording is odd: "Triage", "Decision", a "Renewal" page saying "Your cover has ended", and "I've paid this".
client.fix: Replace internal stage names (Triage, Decision) with client-facing wording.

broker.reasoning: Plain-sentence timelines and "What's needed" are good, but labels like "Structure the risk", "Class/Confidence/Route" and "REGISTRY" chips remain jargon.
broker.fix: Replace the Class/Confidence/Route labels and REGISTRY chips with plain terms.

client.reasoning: Cancel, Back and Close are present, the renewal changes are framed as requests, and accept isn't forced; claim lodge has no visible draft or cancel.
client.fix: Add Cancel and save-draft to the claim form and a confirm-and-undo on invite removal.

broker.reasoning: Principals can Approve or Reject, withdrawn drafts can be edited and resent, and the menu can be closed; there is no visible undo for queue actions.
broker.fix: Add a short undo window after Approve and Reject.

client.reasoning: The shell, bottom bar, "What happens next" panels and card style are consistent; the claim form uses native selects and chips unlike other forms, and Security uses a different layout.
client.fix: Restyle native selects and the Security page to match the app's components.

broker.reasoning: Shared dark shell with consistent nav and keyboard hints, but action patterns vary (Review/More vs Open vs Start early) and the 390px layouts differ between pages.
broker.fix: Standardise row actions and the chip/filter patterns across lists.

client.reasoning: Continue is disabled until the holder is entered, renewal changes are framed as broker-checked requests, and the invite uses presets; pre-submit review isn't visible on the claim or change forms.
client.fix: Add a review-before-send step on the claim and change forms.

broker.reasoning: Principal approval shows the exact files held, the upload is PDF-only and safety-checked, and attachment limits are stated; destructive actions such as Withdraw aren't confirmed in view.
broker.fix: Add a confirm dialog on Withdraw and Reject that restates the files affected.

client.reasoning: Labelled bottom bar, a quick-action row on the policy page, and the + sheet keep options visible; Documents groups by policy and some sections are collapsed.
client.fix: Show the Certificate and Make a claim shortcuts on each Home cover card.

broker.reasoning: Rows show client, what's needed and due by, and shortcuts are shown; the "Schedules and PDS" sections are collapsed and the queue has no context preview.
broker.fix: Show a one-line context summary of the matter under each queue row.

client.reasoning: Shortcuts exist from policy, the + sheet and Home attention cards, plus activity filters; no search and no repeat-holder shortcuts.
client.fix: Remember recent certificate holders and offer them as one-tap choices.

broker.reasoning: Keyboard map (j/k, g-prefix, ⌘K), filters and the More toggle give strong expert efficiency.
broker.fix: Add bulk approve for low-risk queue items.

client.reasoning: Clean, focused mobile screens; the Notifications page is a long repetitive list with test replies, and the claim tracker page is dense.
client.fix: Group and collapse Notifications and move claim detail sections into tabs.

broker.reasoning: Queue and inbox are tidy, but Governance, Alerts and claim detail are very long and dense.
broker.fix: Collapse the lower-priority sections of Governance, Alerts and claim detail by default.

client.reasoning: No error states are shown; the screens show only a disabled Continue, a "Your cover has ended" message, and a "was due" nudge with the "tell your broker" option.
client.fix: Add inline field-level error messages with a fix hint on every form.

broker.reasoning: A dead-end "Only the Operator or Principal can manage people" page gives no next step; the Release Check warning is shown, but recovery guidance for failures is not visible.
broker.fix: Give permission-denied pages a next step (who to ask, back link) and give failures an actionable message.

client.reasoning: "?" explainers, "What happens next" and "Help — contact my broker" are good; there is no central help or FAQ.
client.fix: Add a short searchable help page and link it from Profile.

broker.reasoning: "How this works" playbooks and "?" tooltips are present but mostly collapsed and limited to some pages.
broker.fix: Extend the "How this works" playbooks to the queue, renewals and Governance.

client.reasoning: Home lists each cover with value and status and policy pages state sums and limits (J1 takes 1 tap); Home mixes agreed and market values, and "Cyber — held elsewhere" is ambiguous.
client.fix: Add one plain "Covered / not covered" status line per item, with the sum insured, on Home.

client.reasoning: "Handled by Account executive" and "within 1 business day" are stated, but the tracker has no date for the next step and Messages shows no due-by.
client.fix: Show "With: [name] · next update by [date]" on every tracker and thread.

broker.reasoning: Due-by and "reply by" with Overdue/Answered are clear, but the AE column in Claims shows "—" and the queue has no owner.
broker.fix: Show the owner on every queue and claims row and fix the blank AE values.

client.reasoning: Mostly plain language, but the tracker shows "Insurer claim no. MOCK-FICTIONAL-…", the file list shows "photo: p.jpg", Notifications has "BROKER_REPLY" labels, and the "(MOCKED)" tags are preview-only.
client.fix: Hide system labels like BROKER_REPLY and raw filenames and mock ids from client views.

broker.reasoning: Timelines are plain sentences, but claim detail shows "MOCKED insurer ack MOCK-FICTIONAL-…", the REGISTRY chips and BUILD hash, and "Class/Route" jargon.
broker.fix: Move REGISTRY chips, ids and the build tag to an Operator-only Details panel.

client.reasoning: The general advice warning, AFCA and complaint info, Privacy notice, FSG, and the footer "general advice only" are placed well; the advice warning sits only on some surfaces.
client.fix: Show the general advice warning consistently on every broker-authored recommendation.

broker.reasoning: Principal approval for personal-advice replies and "coverage questions are flags, never decisions" are shown; the statement-of-advice step isn't visible.
broker.fix: Add a Statement of Advice checklist step to the approval panel.
